description: This file defines the ServerRequestCreatorInterface interface in the Nyholm\Psr7Server namespace. It specifies methods for creating server request objects from global environment variables or arrays, and a static method to extract headers from server variables.

classes.name: ServerRequestCreatorInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for creating server request objects from global environment data or arrays in PSR-7 compliant PHP applications.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a new server request object based on current PHP environment variables, including headers and request body.

methods.name: fromArrays
methods.description: Creates a server request object from provided arrays mimicking superglobals ($_SERVER, $_GET, etc.) and request body.

methods.name: getHeadersFromServer
methods.description: Static method to parse server variables array and extract headers.
